# 1 Samuel Chapter 28 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 28

---

### Verse 1
- **EMET:** "-- יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע (know, yes-know): Infinitive absolute + imperfect. Akhish pressures David to commit to fighting against Israel, setting up the crisis..."
- **LOGOS:** "In those days the Philistines gathered their armies for war, to fight against Israel. And Achish said to David, "You surely know that you and your men..."
- **PNEUMA:** "In those days the Philistines mustered their forces to fight Israel. Achish told David, "You understand, of course, that you and your men must march w..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 5
- **EMET:** "And-saw Sha'ul (Saul) the-camp of-[the]-Pelishtim (Philistines), and-he-feared, and-trembled his-heart greatly."
- **LOGOS:** "When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly."
- **PNEUMA:** "When Saul saw the Philistine army, terror gripped him and his heart pounded."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 6
- **EMET:** "And-inquired Sha'ul (Saul) of-YHWH, and-not answered-him YHWH, neither by-dreams, nor by-the-Urim, nor by-the-prophets."
- **LOGOS:** "And when Saul inquired of the LORD, the LORD did not answer him, either by dreams, or by Urim, or by prophets."
- **PNEUMA:** "He inquired of the LORD, but the LORD did not answer him — not through dreams, not through the Urim, not through prophets."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 7
- **EMET:** "And-said Sha'ul (Saul) to-his-servants, "Seek for-me a-woman, a-mistress of-[a]-'ov (medium/necromancer), and-I-will-go to-her and-I-will-inquire thro..."
- **LOGOS:** "Then Saul said to his servants, "Seek out for me a woman who is a medium, that I may go to her and inquire of her." And his servants said to him, "Beh..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Then Saul told his officials, "Find me a woman who is a medium, so I can go and consult her." His officials said, "There is one at En-dor.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 9
- **EMET:** "And-said the-woman to-him, "Behold, you know what Sha'ul (Saul) has-done, that he-has-cut-off the-mediums and-the-spiritists from-the-land. And-why [a..."
- **LOGOS:** "And the woman said to him, "Surely you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off the mediums and the spiritists from the land. Why then are you layi..."
- **PNEUMA:** "But the woman said, "Surely you know what Saul has done — he has cut off the mediums and spiritists from the land. Why are you setting a trap for me t..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 10
- **EMET:** "And-swore to-her Sha'ul (Saul) by-YHWH, saying, "[As]-lives YHWH, if punishment shall-befall you in-this matter.""
- **LOGOS:** "But Saul swore to her by the LORD, "As the LORD lives, no punishment shall come upon you for this thing.""
- **PNEUMA:** "Saul swore to her by the LORD, "As surely as the LORD lives, you will not be punished for this.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 12
- **EMET:** "And-saw the-woman Shemu'el (Samuel), and-she-cried-out with-a-great voice, and-said the-woman to Sha'ul (Saul), saying, "Why have-you-deceived me? And..."
- **LOGOS:** "When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out with a loud voice. And the woman said to Saul, "Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!""
- **PNEUMA:** "When the woman saw Samuel, she screamed. She said to Saul, "Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 13
- **EMET:** "And-said to-her the-king, "Do-not-fear. For what do-you-see?" And-said the-woman to Sha'ul (Saul), "Elohim (a-divine-being) I-see coming-up from-the-e..."
- **LOGOS:** "The king said to her, "Do not be afraid. What do you see?" And the woman said to Saul, "I see a divine being coming up out of the earth.""
- **PNEUMA:** "The king said, "Don't be afraid. What do you see?" The woman said, "I see a spirit coming up out of the ground.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

### Verse 15
- **EMET:** "And-said Shemu'el (Samuel) to Sha'ul (Saul), "Why have-you-disturbed me, to-bring-me-up?" And-said Sha'ul (Saul), "I-am-in-great-distress, and-[the]-P..."

### Verse 18
- **EMET:** "Because you-did-not-obey [the]-voice of-YHWH, and-you-did-not-execute the-burning of-His-anger against-Amaleq (Amalek), therefore this thing has-done ..."
- **LOGOS:** "Because you did not obey the voice of the LORD and did not execute His fierce wrath against Amalek, therefore the LORD has done this thing to you this..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Because you did not obey the LORD and did not carry out His fierce anger against the Amalekites, the LORD has done this to you today."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 20
- **EMET:** "And-hastened Sha'ul (Saul), and-he-fell [with the]-fullness of-his-stature to-the-ground, and-he-feared greatly from-[the]-words of-Shemu'el (Samuel)...."
- **LOGOS:** "Then Saul fell at once full length on the ground, filled with fear because of Samuel's words. And there was no strength in him, for he had eaten nothi..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Immediately Saul collapsed full-length on the ground, paralyzed with fear at Samuel's words. His strength was gone — he had eaten nothing all day and ..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 21
- **EMET:** "And-came the-woman to Sha'ul (Saul), and-she-saw that he-was-terrified greatly, and-she-said to-him, "Behold, has-listened your-maidservant to-your-vo..."
- **LOGOS:** "And the woman came to Saul, and when she saw that he was greatly terrified, she said to him, "Behold, your servant has listened to you. I put my life ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "The woman came to Saul and saw how shattered he was. She said, "Look, your servant obeyed you. I risked my life to do what you asked."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 22
- **EMET:** "And-now, listen, please, also you to-[the]-voice of-your-maidservant, and-let-me-set before-you a-morsel of-bread, and-eat, and-there-will-be in-you s..."
- **LOGOS:** "Now therefore, please listen also to your servant. Let me set a morsel of bread before you, and eat, that you may have strength when you go on your wa..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Now please listen to me — let me give you something to eat so you'll have the strength to go on your way.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 23
- **EMET:** "And-he-refused, and-he-said, "I-will-not eat." And-pressed on-him his-servants, and-also the-woman, and-he-listened to-their-voice. And-he-arose from-..."
- **LOGOS:** "He refused and said, "I will not eat." But his servants, together with the woman, pressed him. So he listened to them and arose from the ground and sa..."
- **PNEUMA:** "He refused. "I won't eat," he said. But his servants and the woman urged him, and finally he gave in. He got up from the ground and sat on the bed."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 25
- **EMET:** "And-she-brought-near before Sha'ul (Saul) and-before his-servants, and-they-ate. And-they-arose, and-they-went in-the-night the-that."
- **LOGOS:** "And she set it before Saul and his servants, and they ate. Then they rose and went away that night."
- **PNEUMA:** "She served the food to Saul and his men, and they ate. Then they got up and left that same night."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

— SOPHIA
